intellectual_tradition: 人民公安工作/军队政治工作
representative_works: 《关于彻底肃清反革命的破坏活动的报告》（1951-03-15）
《公安工作必须进一步地贯彻群众路线》（1958-06-11）
《公安人员八大纪律、十项注意》（1958-08 全国公安会议通过）
historical_significance: 罗瑞卿（1906-1978），四川南充人，中国人民解放军的杰出领导人，新中国首任公安部部长（1949.10–1959.9），1955 年被授予大将军衔（开国十大大将之一）；历任公安军司令员兼政委、国务院副总理（1959.4）、国防部副部长（1959.9，兼总参谋长）、中央军委秘书长、中央书记处书记（1962.9）等职。据 B1 素材包（W1–W21）所载文献：他在 1951 年北京市各界人民代表扩大联席会议上作《关于彻底肃清反革命的破坏活动的报告》，表述「镇压与宽大相结合」的基本政策与「杀一批，关一批，管一批」的分类处置；1950 年主持公安部队编成（20 万人／22 个师，指挥关系属军委、工作关系属公安部）；1958 年提出公安工作「党委领导＋群众路线」的根本路线；1964 年组织推广郭兴福教学法；在纪律作风、中央警卫、军队政治工作与 1978 年真理标准讨论中均有可落源记载。（注：他从未任国防部正职——1959–1971 该职为林彪；1966 年《关于罗瑞卿错误问题的报告》属政治定性文件，1978-08-12 悼词与 1980-05-20 平反通知为其官方评价坐标。）
core_thoughts: 镇压与宽大相结合（1951 北京镇反报告的镇／宽两手与分类处置）
军警分途（公安部队编成：「既是公安，又是部队」，指挥属军委、工作属公安部）
党委领导＋群众路线（公安工作的两个基本点）
郭兴福教学法与群众练兵（典型示范、以点带面）
警卫思想（「一要保证不出乱子，二要不脱离群众」）
人民警察作风与警民关系（从霸王车禁令到八大纪律十项注意）
悼词与平反（官方评价的两道坐标：1978/1980）
政治与军事的辩证统一（反对「空头政治」）
反孤立主义、反神秘主义（专门机关与群众结合的内在要求）
支持真理标准讨论（复出后半年的有限能动）
famous_quote: 我们的政策从来就是镇压与宽大相结合的，现在也还是镇压与宽大相结合的，这乃是我们的基本政策。
famous_quote_source: 罗瑞卿《关于彻底肃清反革命的破坏活动的报告》（1951-03-15；W1，B1 素材包 §三 M-001）
influence: 罗瑞卿主持新中国公安工作十年间，形成以「党委领导＋群众路线」为根本路线、以「镇压与宽大相结合」为政策表述、以《公安人员八大纪律、十项注意》与爱民月为制度抓手的公安工作传统；其公安部队编成方案（军警分途、双重指挥关系）为 1955—1958 年体制调整与 1982 年武警部队组建的体制前史；其反对「空头政治」与坚持军政辩证统一的表述，在 1978 年悼词中获得正式评价，并在改革开放初期的真理标准讨论中被视为支持因素之一。

cross_references.description_zh: 谢富治为 1966 年后接任公安部长的后续人物（其档含公安部「反修防修」运动场景 C-XFZ-001-002 等）；本档 1949—1965 年公安工作条目与其档案在时间线上前后相续。
黄宗羲为明末清初的批判思想家；本档属现代公安与军队政治工作领域，两类条目在「制度批判与治理实践」的意义上可作对比阅读（具体比对另行立卡）。

modes.definition_zh: 两手政策：对罪大恶极的反革命首要分子、怙恶不悛的特务间谍分子、惯匪恶霸与反动会道门头子严厉镇压；对诚心悔改、向人民低头认罪的一般反动分子宽大处理、改造成为新人。执行上先纠「片面宽大」的偏向，再以「杀一批，关一批，管一批」分类处置，并依靠调查研究与证据办事、接受各界人民监督。
modes.definition_en: A two-handed policy: severe suppression for the most heinous counterrevolutionary ringleaders, unrepentant spies, hardened bandits and reactionary sect leaders; lenient handling and reform into new persons for ordinary reactionaries who sincerely repent and acknowledge guilt to the people. In execution, the bias of "one-sided leniency" was first corrected, cases were then classified as "execute a batch, imprison a batch, supervise a batch", and everything was handled on investigation and evidence with public oversight.
modes.source_chapter: 《关于彻底肃清反革命的破坏活动的报告》（北京市、区各界人民代表扩大联席会议，1951-03-15）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们的政策从来就是镇压与宽大相结合的，现在也还是镇压与宽大相结合的，这乃是我们的基本政策。
modes.key_quote_en: Our policy has always been to combine suppression with leniency, and it still is; this is our basic policy.
process_zh: 评估形势：反革命活动猖獗，先纠「片面宽大」的偏向
定策：确立「镇压与宽大相结合」为基本政策
分类处置：罪大恶极者严厉镇压，诚心悔改者宽大处理、改造成为新人
执行与反馈：依靠调查研究与证据，接受各界人民监督，以群众反映检验政策效果
process_en: Assess the situation: counterrevolutionary activity is rampant; first correct the bias of "one-sided leniency"
Set the policy: establish "suppression combined with leniency" as the basic policy
Classify and handle: severely suppress the worst offenders; treat repentant ordinary offenders leniently and reform them
Execute and feed back: act on investigation and evidence, accept public oversight, and test the policy by public response
representative_cases_zh: 北京市、区各界人民代表扩大联席会议报告（1951-03-15；W1）：重申「镇压与宽大相结合」为基本政策；对经过宽大又再作恶者「绝不能再宽大了」；提出「杀一批，关一批，管一批」。
同报告数据与反馈（1951-03-15；W1）：处决五十八名反革命罪犯后，群众反映「政府为人民除暴，大快人心」「枪毙的五十八个，都是罪大恶极的」。
自设边界与用字（1951-03-15；W1）：「依照毛主席的指示」为原文用字（非「按照」）；「决不会根据一两封告密信去捉人，去杀人，我们主要是依靠调查研究，依靠证据来办事的」「决不牵连一个好人，也决不放走一个反革命分子」。
representative_cases_en: Report to the enlarged joint conference of people representatives of Beijing (1951-03-15; W1): "suppression combined with leniency" reaffirmed as the basic policy; those who re-offend after leniency "must never be spared again"; classification into "execute a batch, imprison a batch, supervise a batch".

Data and public response in the same report (W1): after 58 counterrevolutionary criminals were executed, the people said "the government removes violence for the people, to great public satisfaction".

Self-set boundaries and wording (W1): the original reads "yizhao" (in accordance with), not "anzhao"; "we will never arrest or kill on the strength of one or two anonymous letters; we rely mainly on investigation and evidence", and "never implicate a single good person, never let a single counterrevolutionary go".
modern_applications_zh: 刑事政策中的宽严相济设计（罪刑阶梯与首恶、胁从区分）
运动式治理的「纠偏—定策—试点—复盘」闭环
以证据与调查为办案底线、以群众监督为纠错机制
给悔改者出路：改造与帮教思路，防止一味从严或一味从宽
modern_applications_en: Designing the balance of severity and leniency in criminal policy (graded offenses, ringleader versus follower)
A closed loop for campaign-style governance: correct deviation, set policy, classify, feed back
Evidence and investigation as the floor of casework, public oversight as the error-correction mechanism
Leaving a way out for the repentant: reform and re-education rather than pure severity or pure leniency

verification.evidence: 引文逐字取自 B1 素材包（§三 quotes 第 1 段；见证 W1）；核验 pending，入库前须走独立核验流程

modes.name_en: Separating the Police and Military Tracks
modes.category_raw: 公安军与内卫边防体制
modes.domain_en: Public Security Forces / Internal Security Structure
modes.definition_zh: 把执行公安保卫任务的武装力量从一般部队中区分出来：这支部队「既是公安，又是部队」，定名公安部队；规模控制在 20 万人（在 400 万整编数之内、按 5% 分配各区）、拟组成 22 个师，数量不宜太大而质量必须精干；指挥关系属军委、工作关系属公安部，并预置各大军区指挥部的两重指挥关系——军警二元体制的原始设计。
modes.definition_en: Distinguishing the armed force that carries out public security duties from the regular forces: it is "both police and troops", named the public security forces; its size is held at 200,000 (within the 4-million reorganization figure, 5 percent to each region), to be organized into 22 divisions, quality mattering more than quantity; command belongs to the Military Commission while working relations belong to the Ministry of Public Security, with a two-fold chain of command designed in advance.
modes.source_chapter: 《关于建设公安部队的报告》（1950-05-20 全军参谋会议）
key_concepts: 数量不宜太大、质量必须精干
指挥属军委、工作属公安部
modes.key_quote_zh: 公安部队的指挥关系属军委，工作关系属公安部
modes.key_quote_en: The public security forces are under the command of the Military Commission, while their working relations fall to the Ministry of Public Security.
process_zh: 判断任务性质：公安保卫任务需要专门的武装力量
定性与定名：既是公安、又是部队，定名「公安部队」
定规模与质量：20 万人、22 个师，数量不宜太大而质量必须精干
定指挥关系：指挥属军委、工作属公安部，并预置军区指挥部的两重指挥
process_en: Identify the nature of the task: public security protection requires a dedicated armed force
Define and name it: both police and troops, named the "public security forces"
Fix size and quality: 200,000 men, 22 divisions, moderation in quantity and leanness in quality
Fix the command relationship: command to the Military Commission, working relations to the Ministry, with a two-fold command pre-designed through regional commands
representative_cases_zh: 全军参谋会议报告（1950-05-20；W7/W9 引《罗瑞卿军事文选》2006 第 566 页）：「20万公安部队应在400万整编数之内，按照这次整编的5%分配各区」；约 20 万人拟组成 22 个师；「公安部队的指挥关系属军委，工作关系属公安部」。
公安部队领导班子第一次会议（1950-10-04；W7/W9 引《公安部队·回忆史料》1997 第 4、5 页）：「公安部队是国家机器的重要组成部分」；「既是公安，又是部队，或者说是一支执行公安保卫任务的武装力量」。
转引链与后续调整（W7/W9、W8）：毛泽东「公安部队数量不宜太大，但质量必须精干」属转引链（1950-03 政治局），未升格为罗瑞卿原创；1955—1958 年体制一再调整（部分改警察、撤销公安军番号、改归公安部），暴露「建设与使用的矛盾」「条条与块块关系」。
representative_cases_en: Report at the all-army staff conference (1950-05-20; W7/W9 citing Selected Military Writings of Luo Ruiqing, 2006, p. 566): 200,000 public security troops within the 4-million reorganization figure, 5 percent to each region, about 22 divisions; "command belongs to the Military Commission, working relations to the Ministry of Public Security".

First meeting of the public security forces leadership (1950-10-04; W7/W9 citing the 1997 recollection volume, pp. 4-5): the public security forces are "an important component of the state machine", "both police and troops, an armed force executing public security protection duties".

Transmission chain and later adjustments (W7/W9, W8): Mao Zedong remark on lean quality is a transmitted quote, not upgraded to Luo own words; repeated adjustments in 1955-1958 exposed the tension between building and using the force and between vertical and territorial lines.
modern_applications_zh: 武装力量编成设计的「性质—规模—质量—指挥关系」四要素
专业力量与常规部队分轨管理（军警分途）的体制样本
双重指挥关系下的权责划分与协调成本评估
精干化队伍建设：「数量不宜太大，但质量必须精干」
modern_applications_en: The four elements of force design: nature, size, quality, command relationship
A structural sample of running specialized and regular forces on separate tracks
Dividing authority and assessing coordination costs under a two-fold command
Lean force building: moderation in quantity, leanness in quality

verification.evidence: 引文逐字取自 B1 素材包（§三 quotes 第 2 段；见证 W7/W9）；核验 pending，入库前须走独立核验流程

modes.name_en: Party Committee Leadership and the Mass Line
modes.domain_en: Public Security Founding / Line of Work
modes.definition_zh: 公安工作的根本路线是「党委绝对领导＋群众路线」：把公安工作置于党中央和各级党委的绝对领导之下，在工作中放手发动群众、大胆依靠群众。这条路线被称为党在长期革命实践中「一个独特的创造」，其形成伴随着同垂直领导、孤立主义和神秘主义的持续斗争——「两个基本点」既是组织原则，也是工作方法。
modes.definition_en: The fundamental line of public security work is absolute Party committee leadership plus the mass line: placing the work under the absolute leadership of the Party Central Committee and committees at all levels while boldly mobilizing and relying on the masses. This line is called "a unique creation" of the Party from long revolutionary practice, and its formation was accompanied by sustained struggle against vertical leadership, isolationism and mysticism - the "two basic points" are at once an organizational principle and a working method.
modes.source_chapter: 《公安工作必须进一步地贯彻群众路线》（1958-06-11，《人民公安》1958 年第 12 期）
key_concepts: 反垂直领导、孤立主义、神秘主义
modes.key_quote_zh: 把公安工作置于党中央和各级党委的绝对领导之下，并在工作中实行放手发动群众，大胆依靠群众的路线，这是我们党在长期革命实践中一个独特的创造。
modes.key_quote_en: Placing public security work under the absolute leadership of the Party Central Committee and Party committees at all levels, and following in that work the line of boldly mobilizing and relying on the masses - this is a unique creation of our Party from long revolutionary practice.
process_zh: 把公安工作置于党中央与各级党委的绝对领导之下
在工作中放手发动群众、大胆依靠群众
同对立面（垂直领导、孤立主义、神秘主义）持续斗争并纠偏
把党委领导与群众路线固化为「两个基本点」，检查执行是否忠实
process_en: Place public security work under the absolute leadership of the Party Central Committee and committees at all levels
In practice, boldly mobilize the masses and rely on them
Struggle persistently against the opposites: vertical leadership, isolationism, mysticism
Fix Party leadership and the mass line as the "two basic points" and check that execution is loyal
representative_cases_zh: 《人民公安》刊文（1958-06-11；W6）：「把公安工作置于党中央和各级党委的绝对领导之下，并在工作中实行放手发动群众，大胆依靠群众的路线，这是我们党在长期革命实践中一个独特的创造。」
同文（1958-06-11；W6）：「我国的公安工作，是在党中央、毛泽东同志和各级党委的密切领导下进行的」；「它的根本特点就是党委领导和群众路线。这条路线的形成，是经过了同它的对立面——垂直领导、孤立主义和神秘主义的严重斗争的」；「全国公安机关执行党的路线，是坚决的，忠实的」。
回忆转述与出处双注（W13、开放项 3）：秘书傅国祯回忆「党的领导和群众路线是他思想和工作的两个基本点」（回忆转述层）；日期两说并存——CCRD 记 1958-06-11（《人民公安》1958 年第 12 期），文集目录同期篇目记 1958-04-22；「放手发动群众」同篇另有「放手动员群众」异文，均保留双注。
representative_cases_en: Article in People Public Security (1958-06-11; W6): placing public security work under absolute Party leadership while boldly mobilizing and relying on the masses "is a unique creation of our Party from long revolutionary practice".

Same article (W6): the work is conducted under the close leadership of the Party Center and committees at all levels; "its fundamental characteristic is Party leadership and the mass line", formed through severe struggle against vertical leadership, isolationism and mysticism; the organs execute the Party line "resolutely and loyally".

Recollection and dual dating (W13, open item 3): secretary Fu Guozhen recalls that Party leadership and the mass line were "the two basic points of his thought and work" (recollection layer); two dates coexist - CCRD records 1958-06-11, while the collection table of contents records 1958-04-22 for the same period; a variant wording also appears in the same piece. Both are kept as notes.
modern_applications_zh: 政法系统的组织原则设计：政治领导权与专业权力的关系框架
把群众参与作为专业工作的组成部分而非对立面
以「两个基本点」检查路线执行的组织方法
防止专业部门脱离政治领导与群众支持的纠偏机制
modern_applications_en: Designing organizational principles for public-security-type systems: framing political authority and professional power
Treating public participation as part of professional work, not its opposite
Using "two basic points" as a checklist for whether a line is faithfully executed
Correcting the drift of professional agencies away from political leadership and public support

verification.evidence: 引文逐字取自 B1 素材包（§三 quotes 第 1 段；见证 W6）；核验 pending，入库前须走独立核验流程

modes.name_zh: 郭兴福教学法与群众练兵
modes.name_en: The Guo Xingfu Teaching Method and Mass Training
modes.category_raw: 1964 大比武与郭兴福教学法
modes.definition_zh: 和平时期「兵怎么练」的解法：在训练中发现典型（郭兴福教学法），由军委与总参总结、推广，进而形成群众性练兵与大比武；标准是「训练要做到红、硬、活，又红又专；红第一，专第二，但一定要红专结合」，同时在推广中自设纠偏——「不要滥用群众的热情，滥用群众的积极性」。
modes.definition_en: A solution to "how soldiers train" in peacetime: discover a model (Guo Xingfu teaching method), have the Military Commission and General Staff summarize and spread it, and thereby set off mass training and competition; the standard is "red, hard, lively, both red and expert - red first, expert second, but always combined"; and self-correction is built into the diffusion: "do not abuse the enthusiasm and activism of the masses".
modes.source_chapter: 推广郭兴福教学法现场会讲话（1964-01-25 南京现场会；1964-05-24 天津现场会）
modes.key_quote_zh: 训练要做到红、硬、活，又红又专；红第一，专第二，但一定要红专结合。
modes.key_quote_en: Training must achieve the red, the hard and the lively, being both red and expert; red first, expert second, but the two must be combined.
process_zh: 发现典型：从部队训练中识别可复制的方法与教练员
总结上报：把典型经验条理化（电报、汇报与军委指示）
现场会推广：组织高级将领观摩，以点带面、评比检验
定标准与纠偏：红、硬、活，又红又专；防锦标主义、形式主义，反对滥用群众热情
process_en: Discover the model: identify reproducible methods and instructors in unit training
Summarize and report: systematize the model experience (telegram, reports, Military Commission directive)
Spread through on-site meetings: senior commanders observe, then generalize from the point to the area and check by competition
Set standards and correct deviations: red, hard, lively, both red and expert; guard against trophy-hunting and formalism; never abuse mass enthusiasm
representative_cases_zh: 南京现场会（1964-01-25；W20/ch063）：罗瑞卿主持推广郭兴福教学法现场会，对郭兴福说「郭连长，我谢谢你！军委谢谢你！你把兵带活了」；观侦察分队表演后说「这要拿到北京去卖票，也会满座的」。
天津现场会（1964-05-24；W20/ch064）：「训练要做到红、硬、活，又红又专；红第一，专第二，但一定要红专结合」；1964 年被称为「建国以来最好的一年」（W15），军委 1964 年 1 月下达全军学习郭兴福教学法运动的指示（W17）。
归属订正与自设纠偏（W20/ch063、W16）：「郭兴福的教学法是我军传统的练兵方法的继承和发扬……不仅适合于部队，而且适合于学校」两句归属为叶剑英（1963-12-27 电报要点），原稿误记罗瑞卿已订正；杨得志悼文引「把兵都练成这个样子，世界上任何敌人也奈何不了我们」与「搞普及」「不要滥用群众的热情」。
representative_cases_en: Nanjing on-site meeting (1964-01-25; W20/ch063): Luo presided over the demonstration of Guo Xingfu teaching method and told Guo, "Company Commander Guo, thank you! The Military Commission thanks you! You have brought the soldiers to life."

Tianjin on-site meeting (1964-05-24; W20/ch064): "Training must achieve the red, the hard and the lively, being both red and expert; red first, expert second, but always combined"; 1964 was called the best year of military training since 1949 (W15); the Military Commission issued the directive to launch the study movement in January 1964 (W17).

Attribution corrections and self-correction (W20/ch063, W16): the sentences on inheriting our army training tradition and suiting units and schools alike are attributed to Ye Jianying (telegram of 1963-12-27) and were formerly misattributed; Yang Dezhi memorial text quotes "if soldiers are trained like this, no enemy in the world can do us harm" and the cautions "spread the method widely" and "do not abuse the enthusiasm of the masses".
modern_applications_zh: 组织内部「典型示范—以点带面—评比检验」的推广方法论
标杆经验的标准化与可复制化（教练员培养）
训练中价值与技能并重（红专结合）的权重设计
推广过热的自设纠偏：劳逸结合、革命精神与科学精神结合
modern_applications_en: A diffusion methodology for organizations: model demonstration, point-to-area spread, competitive verification
Standardizing benchmark experience and making it reproducible (instructor development)
Weighting values and skills together in training (red and expert combined)
Built-in correction against overheating diffusion: balance work and rest, combine revolutionary spirit with the scientific spirit

verification.evidence: 引文逐字取自 B1 素材包（§三 quotes 第 4 段；见证 W20/ch064）；核验 pending，入库前须走独立核验流程

modes.definition_zh: 中央领导安全保卫的方针被概括为二元约束：「一要保证不出乱子，二要不脱离群众」——安全与联系群众不可偏废。执行上要求「部署周密，不放过任何细枝末节，确保万无一失」，临机处置要快而周密，并把「警卫员」从个人安全升华为新生国家与人民政权的安全。
modes.definition_en: The doctrine for protecting central leaders is summed up as a two-part constraint: guarantee that nothing goes wrong, and do not cut oneself off from the masses. In execution it demands careful deployment, no detail overlooked, ensuring nothing can fail; improvised situations must be handled quickly and thoroughly; and the notion of guard is elevated from personal safety to the safety of the new state and the people power.
modes.source_chapter: 警卫工作方针与实践（1949 年访苏警卫部署；1953-02-14 武汉黄鹤楼警卫；1958-06 三峡水情侦察）
modes.key_quote_zh: 警卫工作一要保证不出乱子，二要不脱离群众。
modes.key_quote_en: Guard work must first guarantee that nothing goes wrong, and second not cut itself off from the masses.
process_zh: 把安全目标具体化为「不出乱子」与「不脱离群众」两条约束
事前部署：周密准备、不放过任何细枝末节，力求万无一失
临机处置：行程临时变更时快速筹划警卫、就地组织
事后复盘：以「向党向人民交代」的责任感检查疏漏，修正警卫方式
process_en: Turn the security objective into two constraints: nothing goes wrong, and no separation from the masses
Deploy in advance: thorough preparation, no detail overlooked, aiming at certain success
Handle in real time: when plans change suddenly, organize guarding on the spot and quickly
Review afterwards: check omissions with the sense of accountability "to the Party and the people" and adjust methods
representative_cases_zh: 访苏警卫（1949；W13）：罗瑞卿提出「要部署周密，不放过任何细枝末节，确保万无一失！」；老同志们概括其作风为「心细如发，事必躬亲，晓衣旰食，一丝不苟」；毛泽东当面要求「不只是要你当好几个中央首长的警卫员，而是要当好新生国家的警卫员，当好人民政权的警卫员」。
黄鹤楼之险（1953-02-14；W20/ch054）：毛泽东临时决定登黄鹤楼，群众围观；事后罗瑞卿说「好险啦，万一毛主席出个什么差错，我这个公安部长该怎样向党向人民交代呀！」——警卫过度与不脱离群众的张力边界案例。
三峡水情侦察（1958-06；W20/ch056）：毛泽东提出要去长江三峡游泳，罗瑞卿带队反复试水，「为证明三峡确实不能游泳，父亲要人绘了图，说明水情，回来报告主席」——以事实回复而非硬拦，兼顾安全约束与尊重意图。
representative_cases_en: Guard deployment for the 1949 Moscow visit (W13): "deploy thoroughly, overlook no detail, ensure nothing can fail"; veteran comrades summed up his style as attentive to the finest detail, personally handling everything, meticulous; Mao told him to be "not just the guard of several central leaders, but the guard of the new state and the people power".

The Yellow Crane Tower scare (1953-02-14; W20/ch054): Mao decided on the spot to climb the tower and crowds gathered; afterwards Luo said, "how close it was - if anything had happened to Chairman Mao, how could I, the public security minister, answer to the Party and the people!" - a boundary case of over-guarding versus staying close to the masses.

Surveying the Three Gorges (1958-06; W20/ch056): Mao proposed swimming the Three Gorges; Luo led repeated test swims and had charts drawn to prove it was impossible, reporting back with facts rather than blunt refusal - balancing the safety constraint with respect for the leader intention.
modern_applications_zh: 要人安保中的「安全—亲民」张力管理
重大警卫任务的分解与冗余设计（周密、万无一失）
临时变更行程的快速筹划与就地组织
以事实与图表回复高风险请求的沟通方式
modern_applications_en: Managing the security-versus-closeness tension in VIP protection
Decomposing and adding redundancy to major guard missions (thoroughness, zero failure)
Rapid planning and on-the-spot organizing when schedules change
Answering high-risk requests with facts and charts rather than blunt refusal

verification.evidence: 引文逐字取自 B1 素材包（§三 quotes 第 1 段；见证 W20/ch054）；核验 pending，入库前须走独立核验流程

modes.name_zh: 人民警察作风与警民关系
modes.name_en: People's Police Conduct and Police-Community Relations
modes.definition_zh: 人民警察与旧警察的分界在于宗旨（全心全意为人民服务）与作风（不搞特权）：整治路径是个案严处→制度立规（八大纪律、十项注意、爱民月）→基层检查→群众监督，并以「群众敢不敢批评我们」作为衡量警民关系是否正常的重要标准。
modes.definition_en: The dividing line between the people police and the old police lies in purpose (whole-hearted service to the people) and conduct (no privileges). The remedy runs from strict handling of individual cases, to institutional rules (the eight disciplines and ten attentions, the Love-the-People Month), to grassroots inspection, to public supervision - with "whether the people dare to criticize us" as the key standard for healthy police-community relations.
modes.source_chapter: 公安队伍作风整顿（1952-08 合肥事件处置；1957 年派出所检查；1958-08《公安人员八大纪律、十项注意》全国公安会议通过）
key_concepts: 不准坐霸王车、吃霸王饭、看霸王戏
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们必须反对侵犯人民利益、脱离群众的国民党作风。不准坐霸王车、吃霸王饭、看霸王戏!
modes.key_quote_en: We must oppose the Kuomintang style of infringing on the people interests and cutting ourselves off from the masses. No riding in bully cars, no eating bully meals, no watching bully shows!
process_zh: 个案严处：对违法乱纪的典型事件从快处理、公开检讨
制度立规：制定并修改《公安人员八大纪律、十项注意》，规定爱民月
基层检查：到北京、上海、武汉、重庆等几十个派出所检查工作、纠正作风
群众监督：把「群众敢不敢批评我们」作为衡量警民关系正常与否的重要标准
process_en: Handle cases strictly: deal quickly with typical violations and require public self-criticism
Build institutions: draft and revise the eight disciplines and ten attentions, and institute the Love-the-People Month
Inspect at the grassroots: visit dozens of police stations in Beijing, Shanghai, Wuhan, Chongqing and elsewhere to correct conduct
Rely on public supervision: "whether the people dare to criticize us" as the key standard of healthy relations
representative_cases_zh: 合肥事件（1952-08；W20/ch053）：公安人员打闹戏院，罗瑞卿令「那位副局长要撤职！公安厅事后不报告，要公开检讨！合肥市那种旧警察作风必须立即整顿！各地要开展反对违法乱纪的斗争」。
宗旨与禁令（W10）：「人民警察同解放军一样，应当把全心全意为人民服务作为宗旨，这是区别于旧警察的重要标志」；「不准坐霸王车、吃霸王饭、看霸王戏!」；1958 年 8 月全国公安会议讨论通过由他修改的《公安人员八大纪律、十项注意》，并规定每年年终或春节期间的一个月作为爱民月。

基层检查与群众监督（W20/ch053、W10、W6）：1957-04-10 重庆曾家岩派出所要求摘掉「官风」牌子、「要同群众千百双眼睛结合起来」；1957-12-12 北京东单分局／小甜水井派出所「民警本来就不是官……要站在他们之中啊」；1958-03 上海青海路派出所「群众敢于批评我们说明他们信任我们，这是好事情」；1958-06-11「群众敢不敢批评我们，这是衡量公安人员同群众关系正常与否的重要标准」。
备选案例登记（W10，宋德贵案 1952-01-16）：「我们内部如果有很多像宋德贵等这样的共产党员，还得了吗？如果这样，我们就有亡党的危险。」——供合并卡与后续场景取材。
representative_cases_en: The Hefei incident (1952-08; W20/ch053): after public security officers brawled in a theater, Luo ordered the deputy bureau chief removed, the provincial bureau to make a public self-criticism, and a campaign against violations of law and discipline across the country.

Purpose and prohibitions (W10): the people police, like the PLA, must take whole-hearted service to the people as their purpose, "an important mark distinguishing them from the old police"; "no riding in bully cars, no eating bully meals, no watching bully shows"; in August 1958 the national public security conference adopted the revised "eight disciplines and ten attentions" and instituted the annual Love-the-People Month.

Grassroots inspection and public supervision (W20/ch053, W10, W6): in Chongqing (1957-04-10) he ordered an official-style sign removed and said work must combine with "the thousand eyes of the masses"; at Beijing police stations (1957-12-12) he said the police "are not officials... stand among the people"; in Shanghai (1958-03) "if the people dare to criticize us, it shows they trust us"; and on 1958-06-11 that this is "an important standard for judging relations between police and people".

Alternate case on record (W10, the Song Degui case of 1952-01-16): "if we had many Party members inside like Song Degui, would that do? If so, we would face the danger of losing the Party." - reserved for the merge card and later scenario use.
modern_applications_zh: 执法队伍职业伦理建设：宗旨、禁令与监督三件套
「个案严处→制度立规→基层检查→群众监督」四环闭环
特权清单具象化（车、饭、戏）以利执行
以「群众敢不敢批评」作为组织健康度指标
modern_applications_en: Professional ethics for law-enforcement bodies: purpose, prohibitions, supervision
A four-link loop: individual case, institution, inspection, social supervision
Making the list of privileges concrete (cars, meals, shows) so it can be enforced
"Do the people dare to criticize us" as an organizational health indicator

verification.evidence: 引文逐字取自 B1 素材包（§三 quotes 第 1 段；见证 W10）；核验 pending，入库前须走独立核验流程

modes.definition_zh: 官方评价由两级文件构成坐标：1978-08-12 邓小平悼词给出定性与生平（「无产阶级久经考验的忠诚的革命战士，中国人民解放军的杰出领导人」「同林彪反党集团坚决斗争的英勇战士」）；1980-05-20 中共中央通知确认悼词「为罗瑞卿同志平了反」，并撤销 1966 年中发〔66〕268 号文件及附件。评价文本（悼词、平反）与记录文本（档案、作品）须分层处理。
modes.definition_en: Official evaluation is anchored by two documents: the Deng Xiaoping eulogy of 1978-08-12 gives the characterization and career outline (a loyal revolutionary fighter tested through long years; an outstanding leader of the PLA; a heroic fighter against the Lin Biao anti-Party clique); the CCP Central Committee notice of 1980-05-20 confirms that the eulogy rehabilitated him and revokes the 1966 document No. 268 and its annexes. Evaluative texts (eulogy, rehabilitation notice) must be handled separately from record texts (archives, writings).
key_concepts: 评价文本与记录文本分离
modes.key_quote_zh: 罗瑞卿同志是无产阶级久经考验的忠诚的革命战士，中国人民解放军的杰出领导人，伟大导师毛主席的好学生。
modes.key_quote_en: Comrade Luo Ruiqing was a loyal revolutionary fighter of the proletariat tested through long years, an outstanding leader of the Chinese People Liberation Army, and a good student of the great teacher Chairman Mao.
process_zh: 以悼词确立定性与生平坐标（1978）
以平反通知确认悼词的评价效力、撤销原定案文件（1980）
涉 1965.12—1966 情节时以传记与档案互证，不单独引用政治定性文件下结论
在研究与传播中使用评价文本与记录文本的分层法
process_en: Fix the characterization and career coordinates through the eulogy (1978)
Confirm the evaluative force of the eulogy and revoke the original verdict document through the rehabilitation notice (1980)
For the events of late 1965 and 1966, cross-check biography and archives; never conclude from the political verdict document alone
In research and communication, use evaluative and record texts on separate layers
representative_cases_zh: 悼词（1978-08-12；W3）：「罗瑞卿同志是无产阶级久经考验的忠诚的革命战士，中国人民解放军的杰出领导人，伟大导师毛主席的好学生」；「罗瑞卿同志是为人民所热爱、为敌人所惧怕的祖国安全和人民利益的忠诚保卫者」。
平反通知（1980-05-20；W4）：悼词「对罗瑞卿同志革命的一生作了全面的、正确的评价，为罗瑞卿同志平了反」；「现中央决定：撤销一九六六年五月十六日《中央批转中央工作小组关于罗瑞卿同志错误问题的报告》（即中发［66］268号文件及附件）」。
史料语境规范：1966 年文件属政治定性文件（其中罪名系当时政治指控），不得作为史实来源，仅可作语境与反证材料，引用必须并置 1978 悼词与 1980 平反结论；三层时间线——档案与作品（1949—1965）、悼词（1978）、平反通知（1980）。
representative_cases_en: Eulogy (1978-08-12; W3): Luo was "a loyal revolutionary fighter of the proletariat tested through long years, an outstanding leader of the PLA, a good student of the great teacher Chairman Mao"; "a loyal defender of the motherland security and the people interests, loved by the people and feared by the enemy".

Rehabilitation notice (1980-05-20; W4): the eulogy gave a "comprehensive and correct" evaluation of his revolutionary life and "rehabilitated Comrade Luo Ruiqing"; "the Central Committee now decides to revoke the May 16, 1966 Report of the Central Work Group on Comrade Luo Ruiqing Errors (Central Document No. 268 of 1966) and its annexes".

Context norms: the 1966 document is a political characterization document whose charges were political accusations; it may not be used as a historical source, only as context or counter-evidence, and any citation must be juxtaposed with the 1978 eulogy and the 1980 rehabilitation; three-layer timeline - archives and writings (1949-1965), eulogy (1978), rehabilitation notice (1980).
modern_applications_zh: 官方评价文本的结构与层级（悼词到平反的承继关系）
人物研究中评价文本与记录文本的分离处理
组织对历史结论的纠错机制与程序
纪念性文本的引用规范与语境还原
modern_applications_en: The structure and levels of official evaluative texts (eulogy to rehabilitation)
Separating evaluative from record texts in biographical research
Organizational mechanisms and procedures for correcting historical verdicts
Citation norms and context restoration for commemorative texts

verification.evidence: 引文逐字取自 B1 素材包（§三 quotes 第 1 段；见证 W3）；核验 pending，入库前须走独立核验流程

modes.name_zh: 政治与军事的辩证统一
modes.name_en: Dialectical Unity of Politics and Military Affairs
modes.definition_zh: 不支持把政治绝对化为「冲击一切」：政治挂帅必须有具体内容（战备、训练、生产实绩），否则便是「空头政治」；面对绝对化指示，以「局部／全局」的区分公开保留异议，并在文件修订中淡化极左倾向（加注「也不能乱冲击一气」）。
modes.definition_en: Rejecting the absolutization of politics as that which may "strike at everything": putting politics in command must have concrete content (combat readiness, training, production results), otherwise it is "empty politics". Facing an absolutist directive, he preserved his objection openly by distinguishing the local from the overall case, and softened ultra-left phrasing in document revisions (adding "nor should it strike about blindly").
modes.source_chapter: 军委办公会议第八次扩大会议发言（1965-01-06 至 09）；对「空头政治」的批评（1963—1965）
key_concepts: 政治挂帅要有具体内容
modes.key_quote_zh: 如果单纯把政治搞好，别的都不好，垮下来，这种政治恐怕不能算好政治，是空头政治，哪里有这种政治！
modes.key_quote_en: If only politics is done well while everything else fails and collapses, such politics can hardly count as good politics - it is empty politics; where is the good in that?
process_zh: 确立标准：政治挂帅必须有具体内容与可检验实绩
公开保留异议：以「局部／全局」区分回应绝对化指示
文本修订：在指示文中加注限定（「也不能乱冲击一气」）
以事实回击：以训练、战备实绩说明政治与军事不可割裂
process_en: Set the standard: politics in command must have concrete content and testable results
Preserve objection openly: answer absolutist directives with the local-versus-overall distinction
Revise texts: add limiting phrases to the directive
Answer with facts: use training and readiness results to show politics and military work cannot be severed
representative_cases_zh: 军委办公会议第八次扩大会议（1965-01-06 至 09；W20/ch065）：讨论林彪《关于当前部队工作的指示》时说「对林总的指示要有全面的正确的理解。我理解林总的指示是指局部的情况，不是指全局，如果那样，岂不是路线错误！」
文件修订（W20/ch065）：在林彪「政治可以冲击其他」后加注「这里是指必要的，也不能乱冲击一气」；并在同期的考察讲话中强调「政治挂帅不是空头的，是有具体内容的」。
对「空头政治」的批评（W15）：「如果单纯把政治搞好，别的都不好，垮下来，这种政治恐怕不能算好政治，是空头政治，哪里有这种政治！」「军事训练搞不好，浪费事小，打起仗来就要亡党亡国」；官方定性见悼词（1978-08-12；W3）「坚持政治与军事、政治与业务和技术的辩证统一」。
representative_cases_en: Eighth enlarged meeting of the Military Commission office conference (1965-01-06 to 09; W20/ch065): discussing the Lin Biao directive, he said "the Lin instructions must be understood comprehensively and correctly. I understand them as referring to local circumstances, not the overall situation; otherwise, would that not be a line error?"

Document revision (W20/ch065): after the Lin phrase "politics can strike at other things" he added "this refers to what is necessary; nor should it strike about blindly", and changed "military training time must be firmly controlled" to "necessary time must be given to military training, but it must also be firmly controlled".

Critique of "empty politics" (W15): "if only politics is done well while everything else fails and collapses, such politics is empty politics"; "if military training is poor, the waste is small, but in war it would mean the loss of Party and state"; the official characterization appears in the 1978 eulogy (W3): "he upheld the dialectical unity of politics with military affairs, with professional work and technology".
modern_applications_zh: 政治与业务的权重设计（价值目标与专业实绩并重）
对上级绝对化指示的「公开表态—私下保留—文本修订」三层操作
组织内异议表达的边界与方式
反「空头」：任何口号都须落到可检验的实绩
modern_applications_en: Weighting politics and professional work (values and verifiable results)
A three-layer response to absolutist directives: open statement on principle, textual revision, preserved reservation
The boundaries and methods of dissent within an organization
Against emptiness: every slogan must cash out in testable results

verification.evidence: 引文逐字取自 B1 素材包（§三 quotes 第 3 段；见证 W15）；核验 pending，入库前须走独立核验流程

modes.name_zh: 反孤立主义、反神秘主义
modes.definition_zh: 侦查保卫的专业性不构成脱离群众的理由：工作中的残余表现为「只相信自己，不相信群众；只相信上面，不相信下面；迷信某些技术，看不到人的作用」；专门机关与广大群众相结合，可以把调查研究做得更好、把同隐蔽敌人的斗争进行得更顺利——群众路线与专门业务互相加强而非互斥；保密要求由「保守工作秘密」条目单独标明。
modes.definition_en: The specialized nature of investigative and protective work is no reason to cut loose from the masses: the residual tendencies are trusting only oneself, only those above, and certain techniques while missing the role of people. Combining the specialized organs with the broad masses improves investigation and the struggle against hidden enemies - the mass line and specialized work reinforce rather than exclude each other; secrecy requirements are separately marked by the item on guarding work secrets.
modes.source_chapter: 《公安工作必须进一步地贯彻群众路线》（1958-06-11，《人民公安》1958 年第 12 期）
key_concepts: 专门机关与广大群众相结合
modes.key_quote_zh: 主要表现为只相信自己，不相信群众；只相信上面，不相信下面；迷信某些技术，看不到人的作用。
modes.key_quote_en: The main symptoms are trusting only oneself and not the masses, trusting only those above and not those below, and superstitiously relying on certain techniques while missing the role of people.
process_zh: 识别残余：列出三处表现（自己、上面、技术）
确立结合：把专门机关与广大群众相结合作为方法论要求
互补设计：以群众路线加强专门业务、以专门业务提高工作本领
划定边界：把「保守工作秘密」作为独立条目，防止以结合之名泄密
process_en: Identify the residues: list the three misplaced trusts (self, superiors, technique)
Establish the combination: make specialized organs plus the masses a methodological requirement
Design for complementarity: use the mass line to strengthen specialized work and specialized skill to raise the work level
Set the boundary: treat guarding work secrets as a separate item so that combination does not become leakage
representative_cases_zh: 《人民公安》刊文（1958-06-11；W6）：指出侦察保卫工作中「还有孤立主义和神秘主义的残余」，表现为「只相信自己，不相信群众；只相信上面，不相信下面；迷信某些技术，看不到人的作用」；「没有真正懂得专门机关和广大群众相结合」。
同文（1958-06-11；W6）：「实行群众路线，不仅不妨碍工作的发展，而且更有利于专门工作的加强」；要「锻炼出一批真正精干的、熟悉政策、联系群众、精通业务的专业队伍，去战胜厉害的敌人」。
同文（1958-06-11；W6）：「有人以为镇反和肃反运动可以放手发动群众，而侦察、保卫等经常业务，就不适于发动群众……也有人把走群众路线同保守工作秘密对立起来。……事实已经证明了，上面这些看法，都是站不住脚的」。
representative_cases_en: Article in People Public Security (1958-06-11; W6): investigative and protective work still shows "residues of isolationism and mysticism", manifesting as trusting only oneself, only superiors, and certain techniques; the combination of specialized organs and the masses is not truly understood.

Same article (W6): practicing the mass line "not only does not hinder the work, it strengthens specialized work"; the aim is to train "a truly lean professional force, familiar with policy, in touch with the people and skilled in the profession, to defeat formidable enemies".

Same article (W6): some hold that mass mobilization suits suppression campaigns but not routine investigative work, or set the mass line against keeping work secrets - "facts have proved these views untenable".
modern_applications_zh: 专业情报工作与群众参与的接口设计
技术手段与人的作用的配置平衡
保密要求与群众参与的边界管理
基层治理「专群结合」与举报机制的制度化
modern_applications_en: Designing the interface between professional intelligence work and public participation
Balancing technical means with the role of people
Managing the boundary between secrecy requirements and public participation
Institutionalizing the combination of specialists and masses, including reporting mechanisms

verification.evidence: 引文逐字取自 B1 素材包（§三 quotes 第 1 段；见证 W6）；核验 pending，入库前须走独立核验流程

modes.category_raw: 拨乱反正与真理标准支持
modes.definition_zh: 复出后的「有限能动」：1978 年 3 月以军委秘书长身份先声支持「实践是检验真理的唯一标准」——「马列主义、毛泽东思想是真理，但不能用来检验自己，只有实践才是检验真理的标准」；住院期间推动军报组织特约评论员文章，并主动担责（「出了问题首先由我负责，打板子打我的」）。
modes.definition_en: Limited agency after his return: in March 1978, as secretary-general of the Military Commission, he was among the first to back "practice is the sole criterion for testing truth" - Marxist truths cannot test themselves, only practice can; while hospitalized he pushed the military paper to organize a special-commentator article, and took responsibility in advance ("if problems arise, I am responsible first - beat me with the board").
modes.source_chapter: 对《解放军报》的指示与推动（1978-03；《邓小平关注军报真理标准大讨论》记载）
key_concepts: 实践是检验真理的标准
modes.key_quote_zh: 什么是检验真理的标准？马列主义、毛泽东思想是真理，但不能用来检验自己，只有实践才是检验真理的标准。
modes.key_quote_en: What is the standard for testing truth? Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought are truths, but they cannot test themselves; only practice is the standard for testing truth.
process_zh: 先声表态：公开支持实践标准，把问题定位为「牵一发而动全身」
组织推动：要求军报加强宣传并参与大讨论
承担责任：为特约评论员文章可能引起的反驳预先担责
边界自觉：以支持者、组织者定位参与，不越位主导
process_en: Speak up first: publicly support the practice standard and frame the issue as one that moves the whole body
Organize and push: require the military paper to intensify coverage and join the debate
Take responsibility: pre-emptively own any backlash against the special-commentator article
Know the boundary: act as supporter and organizer rather than claiming to lead
representative_cases_zh: 对华楠的谈话（1978-03-26；W12）：「这篇文章虽短，却提出了一个牵一发而动全身的重要问题！什么是检验真理的标准？马列主义、毛泽东思想是真理，但不能用来检验自己，只有实践才是检验真理的标准。」
住院期间的指示与担责（W12）：「军报要加强真理标准大讨论的宣传，我也要参加大讨论」；「军报发表特约评论员文章《马克思主义的一个最基本的原则》，可能有人反对，准备驳。不要紧，出了问题首先由我负责，打板子打我的！」
同期遗诗与定位（W3、W12）：「愿君知我心，何畏遮天云。太阳终归出，一样照人行」（《答友人》其一，1975 年仲夏）；1978-08-03 逝世，未及见讨论成果；其作用定位为支持者、组织者而非主导者。
representative_cases_en: Conversation with Hua Nan (1978-03-26; W12): "though short, this article raises an issue that moves the whole body - what is the criterion of truth? Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought are truths but cannot test themselves; only practice is the criterion of truth."

Instructions and responsibility while hospitalized (W12): "the military paper must intensify coverage of the truth-standard debate; I too will take part"; "if someone attacks the special-commentator article, never mind - I will take responsibility first, beat me with the board."

Poems and positioning (W3, W12): "let others know my heart; why fear clouds that blot the sky? The sun will come out in the end and shine alike on all" (Reply to a Friend, midsummer 1975); he died on 1978-08-03 before the debate bore fruit, and his role is defined as supporter and organizer, not initiator.
modern_applications_zh: 组织转型期复出干部的议题支持与组织性推动
宣传战线的议题设置（转载—评论员文章—中央媒体扩散）
对争议文章的责任承担机制
以实践标准检验既有结论的决策原则
modern_applications_en: Issue support and organizational push by returning figures in transitions
Agenda-setting on the propaganda front (reprint, commentator article, central-media diffusion)
Mechanisms for taking responsibility for controversial articles
Testing established conclusions by the standard of practice
